code_identity_contract.submission_value: EXPECTED_COMMIT is the full 40-character candidate SHA supplied to qsub
code_identity_contract.required_equality: EXPECTED_COMMIT == clean worktree HEAD == manifest identities.code.commit

safe_boundary_observation.event: LearnerRuntime emits the callback only after backward clipping optimizer.step scheduler.step and zero_grad
consistency_checks: event learner step base versions local steps and processed tokens equal owned LearnerProgress
all trainable parameter gradients are absent
safe-boundary steps are strictly increasing and cannot be replayed
safe_boundary_observation.mutation_counterexample: a callback presented while a parameter gradient exists must fail before sequence reservation or staging

backpressure_observation.replacement_rule: a newer due snapshot replaces only a not-started pending snapshot
backpressure_observation.immutable_rule: a publishing Proposal is a frozen value and base-context updates affect only later captures
backpressure_observation.slow_writer_gate: fragment zero publication begins before training ends and cannot finish until training has returned

byte_and_frequency_accounting.payload_bytes: product(descriptor.shape) * 4 and exactly the concatenated target-fragment fp32 parameters
byte_and_frequency_accounting.offset_tie_break: nearest free circular integer offset to each byte-weighted midpoint; ties choose the lowest integer offset

identity_chain: bootstrap FragmentGlobalState.content_identity -> adopted base context -> immutable Proposal base metadata, with safe-boundary local step fragment steps tokens sequence payload checksum and reader-decoded latest all equal

timing.gpu_to_cpu_seconds: monotonic interval for target-fragment detach fp32 CPU staging
timing.cpu_to_fs_seconds: worker monotonic interval from publication start through ProposalStore.publish completion
timing.training_interval: LearnerRuntime training start through final pre-snapshot safe-boundary timestamp
forbidden_aggregation: treat skipped or pending work as completed I/O

run_identity.config_identity: raw SHA-256 of the frozen JSON profile
run_identity.model_identity: runtime logical-layer registry digest derived from the frozen seeded model
run_identity.fragment_map_identity: runtime FragmentMap digest derived from the same registry and frozen fragment count
run_identity.base_identity: content_identity of the actual bootstrapped FragmentGlobalState for the target fragment
